title: Dynabeads™ Cell Separation Protocol
author: Manuela De Las Casas
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8sbhwan

steps.title: Resuspend Dynabeads thoroughly
steps.instruction: Thoroughly resuspend the Dynabeads™ magnetic beads in their vial using a pipette or vortex; repeat each time the beads are used.

steps.title: Transfer beads and add sample
steps.instruction: Transfer 100 μL (4 mg) Dynabeads™ to a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube, place the tube on a magnetic rack for 2 min, aspirate and discard the supernatant, then add the cell sample (Sample C₀) prepared in 1X Binding/Wash Buffer to the beads and mix well.

steps.title: Incubate binding reaction
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture for 5 min at room temperature on a gentle balance shaker; incubation may be extended up to 10 min if needed.

steps.title: Separate bound cells
steps.instruction: Place the tube on the magnetic rack for 2 min, then remove the supernatant and transfer it to a new tube labeled Sample C_nb.

steps.title: Wash beads three times
steps.instruction: Wash the beads three times with 400 μL 1X Binding/Wash Buffer, keeping the supernatant in the same tube (Sample C_w).

substeps.instruction: Wash 1 – resuspend beads, add 400 μL 1X Binding/Wash Buffer, place on magnet 2 min, remove supernatant to Sample C_w.
Wash 2 – repeat resuspension, magnet 2 min, remove supernatant to Sample C_w.
Wash 3 – repeat resuspension, magnet 2 min, remove supernatant to Sample C_w.

steps.title: Elute histidine‑tagged cells
steps.instruction: Add 100 μL His‑Elution Buffer to the beads and incubate for 5 min at room temperature on a gentle balance shaker.

steps.title: Collect eluate
steps.instruction: Place the tube on the magnetic rack for 2 min and transfer the supernatant containing the eluted histidine‑tagged cells to a clean tube labeled Sample C_f.

steps.title: Resuspend remaining beads
steps.instruction: Resuspend the remaining beads in 100 μL LB and transfer to a new tube labeled Sample C_ne.

steps.title: Prepare dilutions and plate
steps.instruction: Make serial dilutions of each sample (C_nb, C_w, C_f, C_ne) in LB until a 10⁻⁴ dilution is reached; plate 100 μL of each final dilution on LB agar containing kanamycin.

steps.title: Count cells
steps.instruction: Count colonies or measure optical density using an OD relationship to determine cell numbers.
